0022600090.text: The Indiana Pacers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the New Orleans Pelicans, who also have not played a game this season. Johnny Furphy is out after knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Jarace Walker (undisclosed) and T.J. McConnell (undisclosed) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 127-119 Pacers win in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Indiana a 65% chance to win.
